name: TikTok public profile page
tier_rationale: TikTok Pte. Ltd., an established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted); P118 records provider_tier trusted.

reliability.justification: The platform's own answer is authoritative for the existence and public fields of its accounts; profile fields (names, links, bios) are self-declared by the owner.

error_markers.reason: TikTok served a verify/captcha page: could not verify (never bypassed, A9)
TikTok served empty hydration data (anti-bot answer): could not verify (P118 FC4)

profile_page.title: TikTok public profile page (www.tiktok.com/@{username}, __UNIVERSAL_DATA_FOR_REHYDRATION__ only)

terms.quote: P118 FC2 (binding council text): Terms 'license': TikTok's ToS forbid 'automated scripts to collect information' (legal_dpo, checked 2026-11-26). The module runs only with a licence_allow entry whose basis is provider_grant (TikTok's written permission) or under a research_basis recording such a grant; no terms_clause basis exists.

profile_page.notes: Research C0259: licence-gated (P118 FC2): off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared, and the module itself refuses any allow entry whose basis is not provider_grant. One plain GET per handle per run, >= 5 s apart, no signing/tokens/headless browser/cookie replay/proxy rotation and no retry after a challenge (FC3). Verify/captcha pages and empty hydration data are BLOCKED (markers below) and short-circuit the host for the run (A9).

notes: Batch p3-G05-2 (P118 tiktok_public). Not contacted during the build (licence gate): fixtures are the research subset and synthetic pages; recapture at the first licensed run.
